As coding agents get more powerful, the biggest lever is no longer about shipping features faster — it's building the factory that ships every feature.
At Relevance AI, that's what we're building: an end-to-end system where coding agents pick up a task, build it, test it, review it, and deploy it safely, at speed. We've proven pieces of this already; the next frontier is making it reliable and scalable across every team.
In this role, you’ll own our developer experience, platform infrastructure, reliability and the factory that enables our whole engineering team to out-build with agents. You'll get to shape the foundations of our AI-native platform which everything else depends upon.
This is one of the highest leverage roles in the company: every system you build multiplies every engineer, and every agent, working alongside them — and the infrastructure and cost calls you make is what enables a small AI-native team out-ship a much larger one.
We are willing to sponsor engineers relocating from overseas to Australia.

How We Build ⚒️
We believe that AI is fundamentally changing software and what it means to be an engineer. That means our team works differently:
AI engineering (coding agents, loops, eval) is a core part of every engineer's workflow.

Engineers own customer problems end-to-end, not just implementation.

We prototype quickly, validate with customers, and iterate relentlessly.

We ship continuously, often multiple times a day.

We care about product impact as much as technical quality.

We don't see platform engineering as a gated function or a black box. You'll bring deep expertise and help the wider team build real understanding and ownership of it, not just depend on you for it. That means working hands-on alongside application engineers, with knowledge flowing both ways.

Meet The Team 👋
Paulwyn, Head of Engineering

Peter, Engineering Manager

Your Impact 💥
Own our developer experience and factory — the build, test, deploy, and local-dev loop that lets engineers and agents ship fast, with confidence.

Build agent-safe environments — sandboxes, guardrails, and context that let agents investigate issues, build, review work and ship autonomously.

Own reliability, end-to-end — SLOs, on-call health, observability, incident response and prevention.

Own our cloud infrastructure and cost — AWS, scalability, and spend visibility for the org.

Design and evolve platform capabilities that work across multiple teams and support multiple engineers and agents contributing code.

Remove systemic bottlenecks — every fix compounds across engineering, not just your own team.

Share platform expertise openly, educate the wider engineering team, and create clear paths for others to contribute to infrastructure and platform changes.

Who We’re Looking For 🧠
In one-line: a staff platform builder who cares deeply about developer experience and owning the factory - product-minded, AI-native by default and driven to multiply everyone else's output.
You'll likely thrive here if you demonstrate:
AI-Native Building: You push the frontier of what coding agents can do, and have built the environments, guardrails, evaluation frameworks and context that allows agents to build safely at speed for others, not just for yourself.

Product Thinking & Judgement: You prioritise platform work by its downstream impact on shipping customer outcomes, not by gold-plating infrastructure. You can talk about who used what you built and why it mattered.

Platform and Infrastructure Depth: You've owned developer experience, CI/CD, build/deploy tooling and cloud infrastructure for a shipping team, and you think in leverage: your proudest work made everyone else faster.

Reliability Ownership: You’ve owned SLOs, on-call health, observability, and incident response directly without a separate SRE team to rely on.

Cross-Team Leverage. You’ve improved teams beyond your own; educating, unblocking others and setting standards that other people have adopted.

Belief in our mission. You raise the standard for people around you, you're comfortable with ambiguity and pace, and you believe a smaller AI-native team can out-build a larger, traditional one.

Experience in our exact stack is not required — what matters more is how fast you can pick up a new one, and how deeply you already use AI coding agents as part of your daily workflow.

Why Join Us? 🌟
Work at the forefront of AI with a nimble team that is constantly pushing boundaries. We encourage and celebrate ideas that drive our mission forward.

We’re guided by our six principles: eyes on the prize, work on the factory - not just in it, be truth-seeking, know your customer by name, let's find a way, and momentum matters.

Latitude.sh, now part of Megaport, delivers high-performance Compute-as-a-Service built for latency-sensitive, scalable, and modern workloads. With Megaport’s global Network-as-a-Service platform, customers now gain instant access to dedicated compute tightly paired with private, on-demand connectivity. The Network Team at Latitude.sh is a critical pillar in ensuring stable, secure, and high-performance connectivity for our customers. We operate a robust, complex, and constantly evolving global network infrastructure that supports bare-metal and cloud-adjacent workloads. 
Our environment includes carrier-grade routing, switching, security, and monitoring systems, working closely with multiple transit providers and data centers worldwide. The team is hands-on, deeply technical, and driven by ownership, reliability, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a Network Operations Analyst to join our Network Team, capable of handling operational excellence, incident response, and proactive improvements in a production-critical environment.

Plan and support network expansions, topology changes, and capacity improvements;

Layer 2 & 3 concepts: MAC, VLAN, Trunking, Spanning Tree 

IP networking: ARP, Subnetting, ACLs, DHCP 

Routing: BGP, OSPF 

Transport & management: TCP, UDP, SNMP, NTP, SSH

Previous experience in ISP, data center, or large-scale infrastructure environments;

title: Staff Mobile Engineer, Spend Foundation
description:
About Airwallex
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
 
About the team
The Mobile Foundations team sits at the core of Airwallex’s mobile stack. We build and evolve the shared architecture, libraries, and tooling that power our fully native iOS and Android apps.
 
Our apps help businesses manage global B2B payments, submit and approve expenses, and control both virtual and physical Airwallex cards—complete with seamless Apple Pay and Google Pay integration. On iOS , we work with Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, and async/await . On Android , we use Kotlin, AndroidX, Coroutines, Hilt , and the Jetpack ecosystem.
 
Mobile Foundations is a platform / horizontal team : we don’t just build features, we create the building blocks that enable product squads to ship faster, more reliably, and with a consistent, high-quality user experience.
 
This role can be based in Singapore , Melbourne , or San Francisco .
 
What you’ll do
As a Staff Mobile Engineer on the Mobile Foundations team, you will lead the technical direction of our mobile platform across iOS and Android. You will design and evolve the core architecture, own critical shared components, and act as a multiplier for mobile engineers across product teams.
You will:
Define and evolve mobile architecture
Lead the design and evolution of the shared architecture for our native mobile apps, including navigation, state management, networking, offline strategies, and error handling.

Drive modularisation and clear boundaries between foundation modules and product features.

Own core mobile platform capabilities
Own and maintain shared libraries and frameworks (e.g. design system components, analytics, feature flags, experimentation, authentication, payments, observability).

Be responsible for the application's authentication and authorization mechanisms.

Ensure these components are stable, well-documented, and easy to adopt and extend by product teams.

Improve security, reliability, performance, and observability
Drive mobile application security, including anti-tampering measures, certificate pinning, and security best practices.

Define and track platform-level metrics such as crash-free sessions, ANRs, app start-up time, bundle size, and network performance.

Partner with product teams to drive initiatives that improve reliability, performance, and overall mobile quality.

Strengthen end-to-end observability across mobile (logging, metrics, tracing, crash reporting) and use data to guide priorities.

Elevate developer experience, CI/CD
Own and continuously improve our mobile CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Bitrise), reducing build times, flakiness, and friction in releasing features.

Improve developer experience for mobile engineers through tooling, templates, documentation, and automation.

Manage Mobile Release, Operational Health, and Best Practices
Own the end-to-end mobile release process across iOS and Android, ensuring timely and reliable delivery of new versions.

Establish clear guidelines and lead the on-call rotation for critical platform-level incidents, ensuring rapid response and resolution.

Define, document, and enforce mobile engineering best practices across the organization to maintain a high bar for code quality and platform consistency.

Lead cross-team technical initiatives
Drive cross-squad projects (e.g. rollout of a new design system, major architectural changes, cross-platform feature foundations) from problem definition through to rollout and adoption.

Align stakeholders (EMs, PMs, designers, backend/platform teams) around technical direction and trade-offs.

Be a hands-on technical leader and mentor
Lead by example with clean, testable, well-structured code on either iOS or Android, while setting standards across both platforms.

Provide technical mentorship and guidance to senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and coaching.

Contribute to and influence hiring, onboarding, and the growth of the mobile engineering community at Airwallex.

Minimum qualifications
8–10+ years of experience building native mobile applications on iOS or Android, including at least 3+ years operating at a Senior or Staff level.

Deep expertise in
iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, async/await, or

Android: Kotlin, AndroidX, Jetpack, Coroutines, Hilt with commercial knowledge of both platforms.

Designs for testability and maintainability.

Aligns engineers, PMs, and designers around technical direction and makes pragmatic trade-offs.

Experience defining and driving a mobile platform roadmap , balancing foundational work with product delivery needs.

Prior ownership of shared mobile libraries or frameworks used by multiple product teams at scale.

Hands-on experience with:
Design systems and component libraries on mobile.

Analytics, experimentation, and feature flagging on mobile.

Observability tooling (e.g. Crashlytics, Sentry, logging/metrics platforms).

Experience in domains such as payments, fintech, or B2B SaaS , especially where reliability, security, and regulatory requirements are critical.

Experience mentoring other senior engineers and playing a key role in hiring and growing mobile teams.

Contributions to the mobile community (open source, talks, blog posts) or evidence of thought leadership in mobile architecture and foundations.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Financial Platform - Issuing
description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Issuing team owns the card issuing platform that serves every Block brand — powering Cash App Card, the fourth-largest debit card program in the US, alongside Square Card and the new card programs Block launches next.

We run the full lifecycle of a card: issuance, fulfillment, and activation; real-time transaction authorization and processing across card networks; digital wallet provisioning; 3-D Secure authentication; clearing and settlement; and disputes. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems decide the outcome in milliseconds, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Issuing server engineering team, you will bring deep card-network expertise to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. You will work alongside technical leads and cross functional teams, going deep where our platform meets the networks: specifications, protocols, certification, mandates, conformance, and production behavior.

This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your network expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. You will also work directly with the networks themselves — not only understanding what they require, but knowing where and how to influence outcomes for Block.

You Will

Be a deep technical expert on global card networks, helping Issuing teams interpret network specifications, message flows, certification requirements, mandates, and production behavior — and working directly with the networks to influence requirements, resolve ambiguity, and secure outcomes that matter for Block.

Lead complex, ambiguous engineering problems at the network boundary that span multiple teams, systems, or domains.

Partner with technical leads, program DRIs, and senior stakeholders to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's issuing platform.

Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build certification and conformance tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level.

Drive network certification and mandatory release cycles end to end, and translate network requirements into clear, pragmatic engineering decisions.

Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make network expertise durable and enable teams to operate independently.

Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment.

Apply AI-powered tools throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve velocity and quality, and help establish effective patterns for broader team use.

Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness.

You Have

A minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.

Deep, current expertise with at least one major card network, ideally Visa, including direct connectivity, ISO 8583, authorization and clearing flows, stand-in processing, specifications, certification, and mandate cycles.

Personally built, certified, or operated a live direct network connection — not only integrated through a processor.

Experience working directly with card networks to land concrete outcomes, such as rulings, exceptions, extensions, configuration changes, defect fixes, or certification outcomes.

Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating highly reliable financial or payments systems at scale.

A track record of leading technically complex, ambiguous work across team boundaries and influencing technical direction beyond your immediate area of ownership.

Experience creating durable technical leverage — frameworks, standards, tooling, architecture, or practices that other engineers and teams adopt.

Broad understanding of the card lifecycle, with depth in areas such as issuance and fulfillment, provisioning and activation, authorization, ledgering, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, disputes, or fraud.

Working knowledge of Mastercard and American Express, alongside deep expertise in at least one major network.

Fluency with AI-assisted engineering workflows and sound judgment in evaluating and applying AI-generated output.

Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for critical financial systems.

Block is a proud equal opportunity employer. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, without regard to identity or other legally protected class.

We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

Contact us here  with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering.  Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people.  Square  makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers.  Cash App  is the easy way to spend, send, and store money.  Afterpay  is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time.  TIDAL  is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs.  Bitkey  is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin.  Proto  is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. description:

Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. 

Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.

Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.

For more information visit cultureamp.com .

How you can help make a better world of work

We’re looking for a Staff Engineer to help build Culture Amp’s internal facing Agent Hub, the central technical capability for designing, shipping, and governing autonomous agents across the business.

This is genuinely greenfield. You’ll help define the architecture, engineering patterns, operating model, and guardrails that make agentic systems useful, secure, observable, and safe to run in production.

You’ll work across the wider business to turn ambiguous friction into practical solutions, while creating the platform and patterns that help teams build and operate AI-enabled workflows independently.

As part of this team of amazing humans,

You’ll be one of the founding members of a small high-ownership team building Culture Amp’s agentic capability from the ground up. The Hub works as a central enablement function: setting standards, building shared capabilities, and helping teams across the business move from experimentation to governed, production-ready agents and workflows.

You’ll work closely with AI champions across the organisation. The team’s success depends on strong technical judgment, genuine collaboration, and a bias toward shipping solutions that create real value.

You will

Play a lead role in setting the technical direction for the Agent Hub’s foundational capabilities, including agent execution, orchestration, MCP tools, identity, context and knowledge, evaluation, and operational visibility.

Design, build, and operate autonomous agents, workflows, and integrations for internal use cases — choosing thoughtfully between deterministic automation, simple tools, single agents, and multi-agent systems.

Build reusable MCP servers and tool patterns, including clear schemas, credential brokering, identity-aware access, per-call authorisation, and auditable interactions with systems of record.

Shape the knowledge and context layer that grounds agents in Culture Amp’s organisation-specific information, using appropriate combinations of document retrieval, vector search, knowledge graphs, registries, and semantic models.

Establish the engineering practices that move solutions from laptop-based experimentation to managed services: secure deployment, testing, evaluation, observability, cost awareness, reliability, and safe human escalation.

Partner with teams across the business to identify high-value problems, shape loosely defined opportunities, and deliver solutions that people actually adopt.

Apply and evolve Culture Amp’s agent registry, risk framework, and governance patterns so every deployed agent has clear ownership, purpose, authority, data access, and accountability.

Raise the capability of the wider function through coaching, architecture guidance, reusable patterns, documentation, and playbooks — enabling teams to move quickly within well-designed guardrails.

You have

Strong backend engineering skills (ideally in TypeScript and/or Python), including APIs, testing, service design, and building production systems or integrations end to end.

Hands-on experience delivering and operating cloud-native solutions in AWS, with a strong understanding of security, identity, permissions, secrets, and reliability in production.

Practical experience with AI agents, Claude or similar tooling, MCP or comparable integration patterns, and orchestration across single-agent, multi-agent, workflow, and human-in-the-loop systems.

Working knowledge of agent platforms and runtime concerns such as tool permissions, identity propagation, session state, token and time budgets, retries, evaluation, tracing, cost attribution, and auditability.

Experience designing knowledge or memory architectures, including vector or graph-based retrieval, and the judgment to choose between build, buy, configure, workflow, and agentic approaches.

A track record of taking ambiguous, unscoped problems from discovery through to a shipped and governed solution, earning stakeholder influence through delivery.

The ability to define platform boundaries and self-service patterns so other teams can move independently without compromising security or operational quality.

title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
Dovetail is the Customer Intelligence Platform for the entire organization. We unify fragmented feedback from every touchpoint, including sales calls, support tickets, and research, into a single AI-powered intelligence layer that empowers every team to build, sell, and serve with confidence. Founded in 2017, we are a team of 100+ across our offices in Sydney and San Francisco, working with thousands of teams from Fortune 500 companies to the world’s most innovative startups.
The best never guess. We help teams turn the noise of thousands of customer interactions into the signal required to move faster, prioritize better, and drive revenue.

About the role
As our Senior Web Engineer, you will partner with Marketing, Creative, and Engineering to own dovetail.com end to end. Our website carries our category story, product launches, customer proof, and the paths that turn interest into pipeline.
You’ll own both what customers see and the system behind it. You’ll ship high-craft pages and interactions, while improving the architecture, components, content models, instrumentation, and delivery workflows that let the wider team move quickly without lowering the quality bar.
You do not need to arrive an expert in our current stack, but you need deep web fundamentals and the judgment to improve a production codebase.
This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder. You’ll set direction, ship code yourself, and turn good engineering decisions into systems the whole team can use.
This is a full-time in person-first role (in office 4 days a week), working from our Surry Hills HQ.

What you’ll do
Own dovetail.com. Take responsibility for the production health, technical roadmap, architecture, and ongoing development of our marketing website.

Ship high-craft web experiences. Turn ambitious creative and marketing ideas into responsive, accessible, production-quality pages and interactions. Protect the design intent through to the final browser render.

Build the platform behind the pages. Improve our reusable components, design tokens, typed content models, page-generation pipelines, and authoring workflows so launches, customer stories, solution pages, and campaigns can ship quickly and safely.

Build for growth. Partner with Demand Generation and Growth to improve landing pages optimized for conversation, forms, calls to action, personalization, and high-intent journeys. Implement trustworthy experiments, analytics, and lead integrations so we can see what works.

Make the site fast, findable, and reliable. Improve Core Web Vitals, page weight, image delivery, accessibility, metadata, structured data, redirects, cross-browser behavior, testing, and deployment reliability.

Build an AI-powered web function. Use coding agents and AI-assisted workflows to improve implementation, testing, quality assurance, migrations, and content operations. Build internal tools and guardrails that help the wider team move faster without trading away quality.

Lead through the work. Set standards through code review, documentation, and clear architecture decisions. Explain tradeoffs well and raise the capability of everyone who contributes to the website.

Skills and experience
Taste. A high visual and interaction bar. You notice the typography, spacing, motion, loading behavior, and responsive details that separate a page that works from one that feels finished.

AI fluency as craft. Hands-on with coding agents and modern AI tools such as Claude or Codex, with examples of workflows, prompts, and review loops you have improved over time. You use AI to move faster without outsourcing engineering judgment.

A systems builder. Comfortable owning a web platform end to end, including architecture, reusable components, content systems, build tooling, deployment, observability, and the developer experience around them.

Strong web engineering fundamentals. Five or more years building production web experiences, with deep experience in React and TypeScript plus strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, browser behavior, networking, and rendering.

Performance and accessibility craft. You have improved real-user performance and can build inclusive experiences using semantic HTML, keyboard access, focus behavior, responsive design, and restrained motion.

Hands-on in the weeds. You inspect the network trace, profile the slow interaction, debug the failed build, tune the responsive layout, validate the analytics event, and ship the fix. You do the work, not just design the architecture.

Commercial judgment. You understand that a marketing website exists to communicate clearly, earn trust, and create demand. You can balance engineering quality with launch speed and know where polish materially changes the outcome.

A strong cross-functional collaborator across Creative, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Growth, Product Engineering, Data, and Revenue Operations.

Bias to action. You would rather ship a strong implementation, learn from real behavior, and improve the system than wait for perfect requirements.

Experience with NextJS, GraphQL, Emotion, Netlify, Buildkite, Segment, HubSpot, or Salesforce is useful, but strong fundamentals and evidence of what you have built matter more than a perfect match to our stack.

About you
You sweat the details. You care how the page feels, not just whether it builds. You can hold a clear technical point of view and stay humble when the evidence changes your mind. You have a clear bias to action and can drive to clear outcomes in ambiguity. You will thrive here if you want to compound your engineering craft with AI, rather than defend a pre-AI way of working.

We hire smart people and look after them well! Here's the deal:
📈 Equity for everyone. Competitive base salary plus options, so every builder is aligned on long-term impact.
🏢 A place to do your best work, wherever you are. Our Sydney office is built for in-person first collaboration. Our US team runs on a flexible remote setup. Either way, you've got what you need.
🤝 Built in connection. Join a Doveclub, bond with your team regularly, and celebrate the small wins, big milestones, and cultural moments with the whole company.

🎉 Four weeks at four years. Four years is a long time in tech, and we value loyalty. Take an additional four weeks off to reset and recharge.

title: Staff Backend Software Engineer - Loki | Australia | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This role is available for candidates located in Australia or Singapore.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics , Loki for logs , Tempo for traces , and Pyroscope for profiles . Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and running on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (GCP, Azure, AWS). We also have engineers working on Prometheus , Grafana Alloy , Mimir proxies , and OpenTelemetry.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our tech stack is mostly made up of services written in Go, running on multiple Kubernetes clusters that leverage Cloud object storage.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability.

Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives.

Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.

Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers.

Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope.

Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running.

Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions, and collaborate with the team.

Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system.

As we are remote-first and our engineering organisation is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action.

You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs .

Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively.

Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must.

Requirements:

Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, C, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well.

Some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements and brainstorming ideas, all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way.

Some experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud or some experience with systems engineering.

Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others.

Bonus Points For:

Experience writing low level code for databases, storage layers, or query engines.

Experience working with Kubernetes.

Been a user of Grafana and/or Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools in hobby/homelab projects).

Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, or a desire to learn.

Familiarity with being on-call and performing operations/SRE tasks or with the concept of infrastructure as code.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Australia, the Base compensation range for this role is AUD 190,000 to AUD 238,000.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here .

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

100% Remote, Global Culture -  As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 

Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

description:
Propeller is on a mission to take the guesswork out of moving dirt - reducing wasted fuel, time, and money. We do this through the power of maps.

Our customers use Propeller's integrated hardware and software products to capture accurate 3D versions of their worksites. With over 50,000 worksites worldwide using Propeller's smart survey technology, we empower project teams to map, measure, and manage site activity.

Propeller empowers everyone to approach, own, and solve problems creatively. We're data nerds who care about impact, honesty, and each other. We take pride in being a great place to work and are proud to be recognised as a Fast Company and BuiltIn Best Place to Work. You can learn more about us on Glassdoor .
Requirements
Your Mission:
You’ll join the team responsible for the core processing pipeline that transforms thousands of survey datasets captured by drones and other scanning devices into finished 3D site outputs. As part of this role, you’ll own the design, development, and maintenance of the systems, ensuring they’re reliable at scale, easy to operate, and flexible enough to support new workflows as our platform evolves.
This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact projects spanning multiple teams, gain exposure to core parts of our system, and build a broad range of skills across infrastructure, backend engineering, and some frontend development.
You’ll bring strong engineering expertise, a big-picture mindset, and a collaborative approach. You’ll contribute not only through code, but also by helping the squad navigate change and continuously improve how we build, operate, and evolve our systems.

Your Responsibilities:
Architect, implement, and optimise processing pipeline components that run hundreds of thousands of compute-heavy survey jobs each year
Write high-quality code and review changes from within the squad and across other teams
Support integration of new scanning devices and drones as they hit the market, bringing data from new sensors into the pipeline
Collaborate closely with other internal teams
Maintain internal software products for diagnostics and human-in-the-loop interventions on the processing platform
Mentor and guide mid-level engineers within the squad

Your Skills:
You are excited by complex problems and motivated to learn an unfamiliar domain (this is the key filter)
You have strong backend engineering skills (ideally Node.js and/or Python); comfortable picking up new stacks where needed
You have a big-picture mindset - you understand the underlying problems and make pragmatic architectural decisions that balance immediate needs with the long-term vision.
You are a strong collaborator with great communication skills
You enjoy mentoring, giving guidance, and bringing your teammates along on the journey with you
Benefits
Employee share options
Professional development budget and leave
The opportunity to take part in our mentorship program
Mental health resources
Monthly telephone and/or internet allowance
Paid primary & secondary parental leave policies
Hybrid work arrangements and WFH equipment provided

About Propeller

Propeller is for everyone, so come as you are. We value all types of experience, skill, and ability. If you don't think you meet all the requirements, but still think this role would be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity makes our team more creative, fun, and effective, so bring your whole self to the application process, and we will too!

title: Senior Engineer, Salesforce Platform
description:
Senior Engineer, Salesforce Platform

Xero's Salesforce platform powers our go-to-market solutions and is increasingly the core infrastructure for our agents. As a senior engineer, you'll spend most of your time in hands-on work: writing and reviewing code, joining design reviews, responding to incidents and building proofs of concept. You'll help shape how the platform is secured, released and operated.
Your impact is measured in results. Today the platform runs at 99.95% uptime, with 100% path-to-production compliance, zero Sev 1 or Sev 2 incidents and 150 to 200 deployments a month. This role lets you Go Bold by challenging how the platform is built, Go Fast by removing friction to production, Go Further by building things that last and Go Together by lifting capability across every team that depends on you.

The team and how they connect

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Android)
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Android Engineer who builds and maintains Xero Me's mobile applications, part of our Payroll product used by small businesses, that help employees and employers manage critical payroll and workforce moments (pay, leave, timesheets, expenses, documents) with reliability and excellence. By combining hands-on engineering excellence with mentorship and technical leadership, they directly improve the employee experience at scale while elevating the entire team's engineering craft and capability.
This is a rare opportunity to own outcomes that matter — you're not just writing code, you're shaping how a million of employees and employers experience critical financial moments (pay, leave, expenses). You'll work at a genuine technical scale with the autonomy to design systems, lead API contracts, and drive architectural decisions that stick, not just execute someone else's vision.
Critically, you'll evolve as a cross-platform engineer — Xero is intentionally moving from platform-specific to cross-platform mobile engineering, and this role puts you at the center of that transformation. You'll deepen your expertise in your native platform (Android or iOS) while building real fluency in the other, gaining skills that are increasingly valuable and rare. You'll contribute to shaping shared engineering practices that work across both platforms, giving you architectural influence beyond a single ecosystem.
 
The team and how they connect
You'll work alongside engineers who care deeply about craft, mentorship and learning, and there's a real commitment to raising capability rather than just shipping. You get hands-on technical leadership : meaningful code review influence, direct mentoring of engineers who will grow under your guidance, and a voice in shaping engineering practices across mobile and backend.
The tech stack is modern — native mobile at scale, modern cloud platforms, thoughtful AI adoption for productivity. Plus, it's hybrid flexibility (Melbourne/Sydney), high-velocity delivery without burnout, and the chance to move from just being a strong engineer to being someone who shapes culture and capability. For someone who's built things they're proud of and wants the next level — ownership, impact, cross-platform mastery, mentorship, and scaling influence — this is compelling.

 
Where and how you can work
This hybrid role is based in Melbourne or Sydney, with flexibility.
Our mobile engineering teams are distributed across both locations, with regular collaboration and dedicated boost days that bring teams together to solve problems, share knowledge and strengthen connections.
 
Here are some of the things we're looking for
Technical Foundation:
Android engineering excellence: deep mastery of performance optimization, accessibility, testing strategies, release management and platform conventions; a track record of building robust apps at scale

AI-native development mindset: practical experience using AI (copilots, code generation, debugging tools) to improve productivity while maintaining sound judgment about correctness, security, privacy and over-reliance; comfort integrating AI into your daily workflow

Cross-platform fluency: solid understanding of iOS conventions and the ability to collaborate meaningfully with iOS engineers on shared architectural decisions; valued ability to contribute to backend services, API design, and service integration

Hands-on API and service development: experience designing or evolving service endpoints, API contracts, and integrations (exposure to .NET, AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD is valuable)

 
Leadership & Mindset:
Customer-first thinking: ability to connect technical decisions to employee, employer and business outcomes; clarity about why things matter

Growth mindset under ambiguity: comfort with change and shifting direction; you help the team find clarity and make pragmatic trade-offs without getting paralyzed

Bias for action: preference for incremental delivery and learning through execution over analysis paralysis; shipping wins trust

Communication discipline: translating business needs into technical solutions and explaining constraints/trade-offs with data-driven clarity

Mentorship and raising the bar: genuine commitment to helping others grow; thoughtful code reviews, knowledge sharing and constructive feedback that elevate team capability

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, curiosity and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

title: Senior Search Engineer
description:
The role and impact
This is a role for a search specialist who wants to work at genuine scale. As a Senior Engineer on Xero's Search team, you will help maintain and evolve one of the largest search clusters in the Southern Hemisphere; part of an entire vertical stack delivered to customers. The work is both meaningful and technically stretching: keeping 50+ million searchable documents and 400 terabytes of searchable data at global scale running at 99.9% uptime, whilst contributing to a significant four-year platform rebuild that will shape the next generation of Xero's growth. Maintaining and evolving the cluster to keep systems running at 99.9% uptime whilst serving over 200,000 daily active users

Exploring new partnership opportunities with Mobile, Files, and AI-adjacent search capabilities as the platform evolves

Here are some of the things we are looking for
You bring strong search engineering experience and know what it takes to build, maintain and scale search systems in a production environment handling hundreds of millions of documents

Quality comes first for you – you hold a high bar for the code you write and review, and care about doing things properly

title: Market Manager, Australia
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Our Supply Team is growing, and we want you to be part of it! As a Market Manager, you will play a crucial role in the retention, growth, and optimisation of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts in your assigned territory. These hosts can  You will focus on building strong relationships with these hosts, helping them optimise their listings, improve pricing strategies, and enhance their overall success on Airbnb. 

Hosts are our brand and enable amazing travel experiences for our guests. The mission of the Supply team is to make hosting appealing, rewarding and easy. We are building capabilities that allow us to recruit and retain hosts at a global scale.

 

The Difference You Will Make:

As Market Manager based in Sydney, you will be responsible for the supply health and growth in key markets across Australia and New Zealand managing professional host accounts and supply acquisition of high-quality inventory. You will build Airbnb’s strong market presence in your assigned region by collaborating with other teams as the local in-market expert.

As someone who knows the Airbnb mission and values inside out, you will drive all phases of supply acquisition and market success, including acquisition strategy development, generating and converting supply leads, and strategic partners relationship management, as well as creating them from scratch.

 

A Typical Day:

Manage a book of business consisting of professional hosts, ensuring their retention, growth, and optimisation on Airbnb.

Analyse performance data to identify trends and take action on opportunities that drive increased bookings and host success.

Manage and deliver innovative supply building projects from concept to implementation.

Secure availability over high compression dates, ensuring hosts maximize their revenue potential.

Educate hosts on product updates and policy changes, while channeling their feedback to internal teams.

Respond to host inquiries and provide timely, high-quality support to improve their experience on the platform.

Develop long-lasting relationships with hosts, ensuring they receive ongoing support tailored to their needs

Respond to and deliver exceptional service to your professional hosts  in a timely and efficient manner, occasionally traveling to your market to provide in-person support and guidance

Work cross-functionally with product, communications, public policy, legal and customer support teams.

 

Your Expertise:

5+ years of experience in sales, account management, business development or customer success

2+ years of technology, travel or hospitality industry experience

Exceptional commercial acumen, with a deep understanding of revenue drivers, emerging industry trends, and the competitive landscape.

Strong time management and prioritisation skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively via phone, email, and in-person.

Highly analytical and ability to transform and interpret data into actionable insights for your hosts and the business.

Proven experience working a book of business, driving engagement and growth through proactive account management.

Highly goal-driven, with a strong bias for action and persistence in the face of challenges.

Proven experience working with and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.

Proficiency in CRM tools, particularly working with leads and opportunities (Salesforce experience is a plus).

Charismatic self-starter who is resourceful and self-sufficient

Fluency in English.

 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 
 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Account Executive, SME & Growth

title: Senior Partner Manager, APAC
description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.

 

As the Senior Partner Manager for APAC, you will own and execute Algolia's partner strategy across the region, with a priority focus on Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and South East Asia. This is a technical partnership role: you'll work with consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners to embed Algolia into new multi-technology solutions. Increasingly, that means advocating for Algolia to be built into the agentic accelerators our SI partners are building — AI-driven solution patterns developed in collaboration with Algolia and our technology partners.

This is not a solutions engineering role — you won't be architecting or implementing client solutions. But it is a solutions-focused role: you need real technical fluency, and the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia. In practice, that means identifying and shaping three kinds of agentic solutions: those that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners; those built by our consulting partners and brought to market by them; and those built jointly with technology partners around a shared value proposition that delivers real value to customers and end users. Pipeline development, opportunity progression and customer wins all matter — but they all start with getting the innovation right, with Algolia at the center of it.

Reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships, and working in close collaboration with the General Manager of APAC, you will develop and execute the regional partner strategy — deciding which consulting, systems integration, technology and cloud partners to prioritize, and building the technical and commercial motions that turn those relationships into pipeline and revenue.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

Developing and executing Algolia's partner strategy across APAC, with priority focus on Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and South East Asia

Building and managing a portfolio of consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure) across the region

Identifying, recruiting and onboarding new partners into the Algolia Partner Program, with particular attention to partners building agentic and AI-driven solutions

Shaping and championing agentic solutions that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners

Working with consulting partners to help them build their own agentic solutions on Algolia and bring those solutions to market

Developing joint value propositions with technology partners for agentic solutions that deliver real value to customers and end users

Acting as a solutions-focused innovator who can inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia

Developing a working technical understanding of partner architectures and solutions deep enough to guide partners on where and how Algolia fits — without owning implementation

Enabling partners on Algolia's product and technical capabilities so they can position, sell and deliver successfully

Owning deal registration, pursuit prioritization and account mapping across the partner portfolio

Coordinating go-to-market strategy with partners, including joint marketing, co-selling and technical enablement content

Coordinating across partners, internal sales and solutions engineering teams on strategic client pursuits

Collaborating closely with the APAC General Manager and regional sales leadership to align partner strategy with revenue goals

Collaborating with Algolia Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product and Enablement teams to ensure partner and end client success

Owning pipeline creation and data accuracy for the APAC partner portfolio, with reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships — recognizing that strong pipeline, opportunity progression and customer wins all start with the right solution innovation involving Algolia

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

7-10+ years of experience in a senior Alliance, Channel or Partner role, ideally with technology, cloud or systems integration partners, in a recurring revenue business model

Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, search/AI architecture, cloud infrastructure and how multiple technologies combine into a single solution, without being a hands-on engineer

Familiarity with the emerging landscape of agentic AI and the accelerator programs being built by systems integrators and technology partners

Experience working with cloud partners (AWS, Microsoft Azure) and/or major systems integrators (e.g., Accenture, Cognizant, Publicis Groupe, Valtech)

Business-side understanding of SaaS software, search/AI, headless commerce and API-first architectures

A track record of developing and executing regional partner strategy, ideally across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and South East Asia

Salesforce.com experience creating and managing opportunities through the sales cycle, with high attention to data accuracy and quality

Excellent communicator, writer and storyteller, with a strong ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders

A history of developing and nurturing long-term industry and partner relationships

A history of becoming a trusted advisor to partners, clients and internal stakeholders, including senior leadership

A solutions-oriented mindset — genuinely creative and innovative, with the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia

Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy across a large, diverse region

A track record of driving joint co-selling and co-marketing activities

Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, both internally and externally

#LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

$300,500 — $375,500 AUD

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. 

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

description:

About the role

Anthropic’s APAC go-to-market organisation is the fastest-growing part of our international business, spanning markets with distinct languages, cultures and buying styles. Today, enablement for the region is delivered by our global and EMEA teams. As we scale in APAC, we are establishing an initial in-region enablement presence, based in Sydney and supporting the field across the region.

As Enablement Lead, you will be hands-on in getting the APAC field ready: onboarding, ongoing skill development, manager coaching support and launch readiness, across GTM functions, not just sales. You will spend most of your time in the room, running sessions, building programmes and working directly with sellers and managers, in the time zones and languages where customer conversations happen.

This is a build role with a global spine. You inherit a working global and international enablement engine. Your job is to adapt it for APAC, deliver it across the region, and feed what you learn back into the international and global programme.

How we work: adults learn by doing, so we build sessions around live activity: practice, reflection, real customer scenarios. The measure is not what was covered in the room. It is what changes a week later in how people think, decide and sell.

This takes creativity and a solid understanding of how adults learn, applied at speed. The frontier moves quickly and the field is scaling fast. Much of the work is unlearning: helping experienced sellers let go of pre-AI habits, not just teaching new ones. AI is what makes this scalable: endless practice partners, personalised scenarios from real deals, feedback minutes after a call. You will use it that way, not to generate more content.

Key responsibilities

Set up the APAC enablement rhythm: in-region onboarding cohorts, live practice-based sessions in APAC time zones, and a feedback loop into the global programme

Adapt the international portfolio for APAC, where content for several markets needs to be written and translated ahead of delivery

Personally design and facilitate deal walkthroughs, role-plays and customer-conversation rehearsal, favouring practice over presentation

Partner with regional GTM leaders to build a coaching standard that scales as the manager layer grows

Own launch readiness for the region, so that when a new model or product ships, the APAC field is certified and conversation-ready in the same week cycle as everyone else

Build the measurement habit: track what the field does differently afterwards, not content shipped or attendance

Minimum qualifications

8+ years in GTM enablement, sales productivity or similar roles, including experience leading or running enablement programmes

Experience delivering GTM enablement in APAC, ideally across more than one of the region’s markets

Experience influencing beyond your own team or region, such as a programme adopted elsewhere or a senior stakeholder whose decision you changed

Hands-on track record designing and running practice-first enablement, measured by changes in field behaviour

A working understanding of how adults learn, and comfort helping experienced sellers unlearn pre-AI habits

Creativity with AI in your craft: personalised practice, real-deal scenarios and fast feedback rather than more content

Experience owning programmes end to end, from design through delivery and measurement

Experience enabling a field across languages and cultures, and knowing what breaks when English-first content ships as-is

Comfort working with sales leaders as a peer, including pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecast conversations

Good judgement on when to adapt global programmes and when to adopt them as-is

Strong candidates may also

Have held both a global and an APAC enablement role

Have run enablement delivered across multiple APAC markets

Have helped build or scale an enablement function

Have carried a quota or led sellers earlier in their career

Have enablement experience in AI, developer platforms or technical products sold to both executives and builders

Have built manager or coaching programmes, not just individual-contributor enablement

Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

title: Head of SMB Acquisition
description:
We started a movement in which everyone can win – shoppers, retailers, society and every person on our team. To play fair, trust people and reward them for doing the right thing. We see and feel the impact of our work as more and more people gain financial freedom and retailers grow across the globe.

Founded in 2014 in Sydney, Australia, Afterpay has over 24 million active customers globally and more than 250,000 of the best retailers around the world including Anthropologie, Revolve, DSW, GOAT, Finish Line, Levi’s, Mac Cosmetics, Ray-Ban and many others.

Afterpay is helping people spend responsibly! We empower customers to access the things they want and need, while still allowing them to maintain financial wellness and control, by splitting payments in four, for both online and in-store purchases. Afterpay is deeply committed to delivering positive outcomes for customers. Now under the Block ecosystem, we are focused on supporting our community of shoppers.

We trust in the next generation and share a vision of a more accessible and sustainable world in which people are rewarded for doing the right thing.  

The Role

The Australia and New Zealand SMB & Franchise Sales team at Afterpay is responsible for driving revenue to our core consumer payments business, giving our Merchant partners access to one of the largest and most engaged networks of next generation consumers.

We are looking for a strategic, analytical, high-energy, and experienced Head of SMB Acquisition Sales to lead and scale a high-velocity, playbook-driven sales engine across a broad and growing base of small and medium-sized businesses, while forging and expanding relationships with fast-growing and established Franchise partners. The SMB segment spans multiple motions, including a BDR function that sources and books meetings for Account Executives, an Inbound motion serving smaller, higher-volume businesses, and an Outbound-led motion focused on larger, higher-growth SMB and Premium SMB segments. The Franchise motion adds a higher-touch, more sophisticated sales environment focused on winning and expanding relationships with leading franchise groups and brands from SMB’s through to Mid and Enterprise size prospects. You will be responsible for orchestrating these motions into a cohesive system and for the discipline, tooling, processes, and deal strategies that help generate pipeline, convert opportunities, onboard merchants efficiently, and win business at scale.

A successful candidate exhibits a strong sense of ownership to win new business for Afterpay and a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity; think strategically and operationally about business, marketing, product, and technical challenges; and lead cross-functional workstreams ultimately tied to pipeline creation, conversion, and revenue growth. This role requires a strategic problem solver who is a rigorous operator, relentless negotiator, and effective influencer, comfortable balancing data-driven rigor and scalable sales processes with high-touch relationship building, a strong bias for action, and hands-on execution.

Beyond ultimately being responsible for revenue outcomes across our SMB & Franchise merchant pipeline - spanning a broad range of industries across retail, fashion, beauty, travel, QSR, home and more across Australia and New Zealand - you will also be responsible for building and supporting a strong culture of performance. You will develop leaders and individual contributors, create clarity and accountability across the organization, and lead with empathy without ego.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated excellence in building and operating high-velocity sales motions at scale, navigating complex commercial negotiations, leading and managing high-performing teams, and continuously improving how teams sell, operate, and deliver results.

You Will

Oversee the A/NZ SMB & Franchise Sales Team: Lead a multi-motion organization spanning BDR, Inbound and Outbound Account Executives, together with the Franchise sales motion. Build and continuously refine the playbooks, processes and tooling that let the team convert and grow merchants efficiently at high volume while also enabling sophisticated, high-touch Franchise deal execution. Craft a segment-wide strategy and hold the team accountable to delivering on OKRs and revenue targets across each motion, in concert with the broader Sales & Account Management function at Afterpay.

Build an A-Team: Inherit and further develop a team of strong performers and leaders with relevant experience. Build their skills, knowledge, efficacy, and an overall culture focused on performance and continuous improvement, including coaching frontline managers to drive results through their own teams. Set an energetic and accountable tone for the A/NZ sales organization, rooted in a strong sense of ownership and led with empathy over ego.

Develop Meaningful Cross-Functional Partnerships: Work closely with cross-functional teams to better support your team in generating revenue, including Marketing, Finance, Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Account Management, Partnerships and more. Influence without authority across teams and build the internal relationships required to navigate a distributed, global and matrixed set of stakeholders.

Own Sales Process and Methodology: Build and refine repeatable sales approaches across the full deal lifecycle - from prospecting, discovery and qualification through articulating value, solutioning, negotiating, contracting, closing and onboarding. Balance standardized, scalable SMB motions with the flexibility and commercial judgment required for more complex Franchise opportunities.

Craft Deal Strategy:  Develop and pitch powerful sales narratives that educate prospective merchants on Afterpay's value proposition. Coach the team through sophisticated deal negotiations, support internal and external advocacy, clear blockers to revenue, and effectively communicate with senior decision makers at high-growth and established brands and franchise groups.

Drive Forecasting Rigor and Pipeline Hygiene: Implement and maintain best practices in forecasting accuracy, pipeline coverage, pipeline health, opportunity progression, and conversion. Partner closely with Finance and Sales Strategy / Operations to ensure forecasts are rigorous, risks and upside are understood, and the organization is focused on the activities and opportunities that will drive outcomes.

Define Ideal Customer Profile and Value Proposition: Shape and sharpen our ideal customer profiles, priority use cases, and value propositions across SMB and Franchise. Leverage insights, data and market intelligence to centralize and socialize the sales and growth narratives that resonate most with merchants and inform our broader B2B marketing, product and go-to-market strategy.

Drive Portfolio and Segment Strategy: Leverage insights across the team's pipeline and merchant portfolio to identify priority industries, franchise networks, growth opportunities and emerging trends. Translate those insights into clear segment strategies, scalable acquisition motions and commercial priorities across Australia and New Zealand.

Be the Voice of Afterpay: Represent the business to SMB and Franchise merchants as a thought leader in payments and Buy Now Pay Later, demonstrating Afterpay's value as a growth driver for small, growing and established businesses. Develop and grow Block's relationships with merchant partners, including senior leadership teams where appropriate.

Be the Voice of the Merchant: Represent market feedback and sentiment internally, advocating for merchants while balancing the needs and constraints of our business. Aggregate and deliver key insights across the organization in a structured, consistent and proactive manner to influence product, marketing, risk and commercial priorities.

You Have

An obsession with our products and a motivation fueled by feeling the impact of your work as more consumers build financial wellness with Afterpay.

12+ years of experience in high-growth environments leading SMB Sales, Franchise Sales, BDR, Mid-Market Sales, or Account Management organizations, preferably in a fast-moving technology, payments, or financial services company, with experience operating across both high-volume sales motions and complex commercial relationships.

Excellent leadership skills with the ability to develop talent, motivate high-performing teams, and build strong cross-functional relationships, including a proven track record of coaching and managing frontline managers to results. You put your people in the best position to succeed, and your management style is tailored to each individual to maximize their performance and engagement at work.

Experience standing up, scaling, or transforming sales organizations - hiring, onboarding and developing talent across BDRs, AEs, and frontline managers, and designing the structures and operating rhythms required to support growth.

Demonstrated ability to build, operate, and continuously improve playbooks that scale across a large and growing team while preserving the judgment and flexibility required for sophisticated deals.

A demonstrated track record of leading teams that consistently drive revenue growth and exceed their revenue targets, including experience with sophisticated commercial negotiations and established clients.

Proven experience navigating and operating effectively within matrixed global organizations and aligning regional priorities with broader global strategies.

Experience working closely with Product and Marketing to drive conversion, including improving merchant acquisition, sign-up, activation and onboarding journeys, and translating merchant needs into product and go-to-market opportunities.

A high familiarity and comfort with how product development works, preferably in payments. You can hold your own with stakeholders across technical, marketing, product and commercial disciplines and have credibility with Product and Engineering partners.

Strong executive presence, with demonstrated ability to influence and earn trust with senior internal leaders and external decision makers, ask the right questions, and use sound business judgment, including with C-suite stakeholders at larger merchant and franchise partners.

An operational mindset as well as a strategic one - you can set a clear vision, implement robust processes, lead teams through complex relationships, and translate strategy into disciplined execution.

Comfort working with analytics and tools that support business performance measurement and management, particularly forecasting, funnel, pipeline, conversion, productivity and revenue metrics at scale.

Creative storytelling abilities, with the ability to seek out relevant, meaningful data and build compelling business cases and sales narratives that demonstrate Afterpay's value proposition.

A scrappy and humble mindset, where toggling between team lead and in-the-weeds work is business as usual.
